deep_observation: 漏译关键指代物并改写句子结构。补查：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；第 2634 行 define_as="SET_SCEPTRE_LICH"、第 2637 行 name="Sceptre of the Archlich"，第 2668 行 on_wear 中 descriptor.race=="Undead" 时于第 2677 行 game.logPlayer 输出本条。该提示正是玩家装备“大巫妖权杖”瞬间的反馈，source 的 "the power of the sceptre" 指明力量来自该权杖；译文“强大的力量”完全删去 sceptre/权杖，玩家无法得知是哪件装备触发，且凭空添加了源文没有的“强大”。同时 "flow over your undead form"（力量流过你的亡灵之躯）被改写为条件状语“在亡灵形态下……流动”，把力量作用于亡灵躯体这一对象关系降级为触发条件描述。

deep_observation: 多处语义错译与漏译。补查：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/zones/last-hope-graveyard/zone.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 186-194 行 on_enter 在 lev==2 时以 Dialog:simpleLongPopup(_t"Mausoleum", ...) 弹出本段（第 189-193 行）。(1) "A hall of doors lies ahead" 指前方是一条／一片排满门的厅道，与同段后文 "At the end of the corridor" 相呼应；译文“前方是一排门厅”把“门”与“厅”颠倒成“成排的门厅（前厅）”，空间描述失真。(2) "They echo round the dark chamber and through the darkest parts of your mind" 中 "the darkest parts of your mind"（你心底最幽暗之处）是回声所及的第二个处所；译文“通过黑暗传入了你的大脑”把它误读为传播媒介“黑暗”，丢失“内心最阴暗处”的含义。(3) "every black deed and vile sin you have ever committed" 的“每一桩恶行与卑劣罪孽”被压缩为“每一项罪过”，丢掉 black deed/vile sin 的并列与色彩。(4) "each competing for stronger control of your psyche"（三者相互争夺对你心智的更强控制权）被改写为“它们每个都紧紧抓住了你的灵魂”，取消了彼此竞争这一关系，且 psyche（心智）改作“灵魂”。
source:
As you tread softly down the stairs a large stone slab slides into place behind you, blocking all retreat. The air is still and stuffy, and in this tight space you feel as if in a coffin, buried alive.

Adding to your unease is a rising feeling of dread, overwhelming fear in fact. A hall of doors lies ahead, and behind each you sense a power of great malevolence and unholy horror. At the end of the corridor you see a faint light beneath a large black door, and you have a vague sense that the other doors are enslaved to this one - obedient, subservient, and waiting...

You hear the sound of a woman sobbing, and every now and then it turns into a fit of pained moans and screams. They echo round the dark chamber and through the darkest parts of your mind, reminding you of every black deed and vile sin you have ever committed. Guilt, horror and terror flood through your thoughts, each competing for stronger control of your psyche. Your only clear thought is of escape, by whatever means you can find.
surface_observation: a hall of doors 指有多扇门的厅廊，译成“一排门厅”改变了空间含义；through the darkest parts of your mind 指声音回荡于内心最黑暗处，译成“通过黑暗传入了你的大脑”改变了原文意象。
target:
当你蹑手蹑脚地走下楼梯时，一块巨大的石板在你身后滑入原位，堵住了所有退路。空气凝滞而闷热，在这狭小的空间里，你感觉自己仿佛被活埋进了棺材。

更令你不安的是不断攀升的恐惧感，事实上是压倒性的恐惧。前方是一排门厅，每扇门后你都能感觉到巨大的恶意和不洁的恐怖。走廊尽头，一扇巨大的黑色门下透出微弱的灯光，你隐约感到其他门都臣服于这扇门——顺从、恭顺，静静等待……

你听到一个女人的哭泣，时不时还夹杂着一声痛苦的哀嚎和尖叫。声音在密室里回荡并且通过黑暗传入了你的大脑，提醒你所犯的每一项罪过。内疚、恐怖和害怕如潮水般袭来，它们每个都紧紧抓住了你的灵魂。你唯一的想法便是逃离此地，不择一切手段。

source: This thick-set mace was used by the Spellhunter Vorlan, who crafted it from the wood of an ancient oak that was uprooted during the Spellblaze.  Many were the wizards and witches felled by this weapon, brought to justice for the crimes they committed against nature.
target: 这把加粗的权杖曾属于猎魔人沃尔兰，他从一棵在魔法大爆炸中被连根拔起的古老橡树中取材制造了它。众多法师和女巫倒在了这把武器之下，他们对自然犯下的罪行得到了制裁。

deep_observation: 占位符语法角色被改写，且擅自补上句号破坏外层句式。补查：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/chats/sorcerer-end.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 179 行 player:die(player, {special_death_msg=("sacrificing %s to stop the Way"):tformat(string.his_her_self(player))})；game/engines/default/engine/utils.lua 同 commit 第 953-958 行 string.his_her_self 返回 herself/itself/himself。故 %s 是 sacrificing 的反身宾语（他自己／她自己／它自己），主语是外层格式里的玩家名。该 special_death_msg 的消费点为 game/modules/tome/class/interface/PartyDeath.lua 同 commit 第 122-127 行：msg = ("%s the level %d %s %s %s on level %s of %s."):tformat(玩家名, 等级, 种族, 职业, death_note.special_death_msg, 层数, 区域名)，即本串只是嵌在句中的谓语短语。译文“%s牺牲自己，阻止了维网。”把 %s 当成句子主语，实际渲染成“他自己牺牲自己”这类反身代词重复；末尾自加“。”会在外层“……于 X 的第 N 层。”之前提前断句，使整条死亡讯息割裂成两句。
surface_observation: 原文 sacrificing %s 中 %s 是被牺牲的对象，译文“%s牺牲自己”将其改成了主动自我牺牲的主体。

source: Equilibrium represents your standing in the grand balance of nature. The closer it is to 0 the more balanced you are. Being out of equilibrium will adversely affect your ability to use Wild Gifts.

source: This crystalline tree branch is remarkably rigid, and refracts light in myriad colors. Gazing at it entrances you, and you worry where its power may have come from.
target: 这根水晶树枝异常坚硬，折射出万千色彩的光芒。凝视着它会让你入迷，同时你会担心它的力量究竟来自何处。

source:
#{bold}#Relle, Cornac Fighter and Expedition Leader#{normal}#
It knows we're here.  Xann's gone, and I have to assume the worst.  Too late to run.  One option left, a contraption Sodelost ensured us he'd be able to use to get the kill...  shame he didn't leave instructions behind with it, it's unclear how to arm it, and I don't want to add "being charred to a crisp" to my list of troubles today.
I might not know a great deal about artifice, but I know how wild animals work, and for all the praise they get, dragons are no better.  I don't need to know how to rig this device so it goes off when the beast steps on it - I just need to put it inside something it'll eat whole...
#{italic}#Judging from this note's intact state and delicate placement next to a sack covered in assorted animal viscera, the dragon not only avoided setting off the trap, but has kept it as a trophy.  Inside the sack is a disarmed trap featuring a few recognizable alchemical flasks, and a means of mixing them in the right proportion when a pressure plate is triggered to produce a blast of dragonsfire. Figuring out how to arm it is almost as easy as figuring out how to make more traps like it.#{normal}#
surface_observation: 原文在 troubles today. 与 I might 之间为单个换行，译文对应位置在“这一项。”后变为两个换行，增加了空行；全文换行数由3变为4。
target:
#{bold}#探险队队长，科纳克人战士瑞丽#{normal}#
那条龙知道我们在这里。希安失踪了，我只能作最坏的打算。逃跑已经太迟。只剩一个选择：苏达罗斯特向我们保证，他能用这套装置杀死那条龙……可惜他没把说明留在装置旁边，没人知道该如何启动它，而我可不想让今天的麻烦清单再多出“被烧成焦炭”这一项。

我或许不太懂机关术，却知道野兽会怎么做。龙尽管备受赞颂，在这一点上也不比其他野兽高明。我无需知道怎样把装置设成野兽踩中时触发——只须将它放进某种会被一口吞下的东西里……
#{italic}#从纸条完好无损的状态，以及它被小心摆放在一个沾满各种动物内脏的袋子旁边来看，那条龙不仅没有触发陷阱，还把它当作战利品收藏了起来。袋中有一个已解除的陷阱，装有几只尚能辨认的炼金药瓶；压力板触发时，机关会按正确比例混合其中的药剂，爆发出龙火。弄清如何启动它，几乎与弄清如何制作更多同类陷阱一样简单。#{normal}#

source:
Using your near-perfect knowledge of beam spells you combine them all into a powerful 3-wide beam of pure energy.
		The beam deals %0.2f thaumic damage and always goes as far as possible.

deep_observation: 机制误述：把“禁止存取”说成“没有物品栏”。补查：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/class/Store.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 279-284 行 _M:interact(who, name) 中 if who.no_inventory_access then game.logPlayer(who, "This entity can not access inventories.") return end——拦截的是该 actor 打开商店／物品栏界面的行为。同 commit game/modules/tome/class/Actor.lua 第 105 行 _M.clone_copy = table.merge({no_drops=true, no_rod_recall=true, no_inventory_access=true, ...})，另见第 4447、7951、8008、8076 行同一标志的拦截点（第 8076 行 no_inventory_access or not dst:canAddToInven(dst.INVEN_INVEN) 拦截物品转移）。即带此标志的实体（如分身 clone）本身仍持有并穿戴装备，只是被禁止存取物品栏，并非不存在物品栏。译文“这个生物没有物品栏。”把权限限制说成容器缺失，与代码事实相反，玩家会误以为该单位身上无装备可取。

deep_observation: 凭空增加源文没有的身体部位，且与槽位语法冲突。补查：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/damage_types.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 765-778 行 PHYSICAL 伤害类型的 death_message 列表共 31 项（battered/bludgeoned/sliced/…/stabbed/pierced/torn limb from limb/…/skewered/…），"stabbed"（第 778 行）只是其中随机抽取的一项泛用物理死法分词，源文不含任何部位信息。消费点为 game/modules/tome/class/interface/PartyDeath.lua 同 commit 第 69-72 行 death_mean = rng.table(dt.death_message)，再于第 110、117 行填入 ("%s the level %d %s %s was %s to death by %s%s%s on level %s of %s.") 的 "was %s to death by" 槽位，该槽位本身已由 was…by 提供被动语态。译文“被刺破喉咙”既臆造出源文没有的“喉咙”（任何物理死因都会随机命中此条，包括投射物、践踏、碾压等场景），又自带“被”字与槽位外层的被动结构重复；同表中已有 pierced/impaled/skewered 等近义项，此译法还会与它们撞车而丧失区分度。
surface_observation: 原文 stabbed 仅表示被刺，译文“被刺破喉咙”额外指定了原文未提及的受伤部位及伤情。
